# vyos.blueprints.wireguard

WireGuard interfaces and peers

- Creates WireGuard interfaces with their addresses, listen port, private key and peers, in VyOS 1.4+/1.5 syntax (peer `public-key`, `address`, `port`).
- Configured with vyos.vyos.vyos_config, because vyos.vyos has no WireGuard module yet. Keys are masked in rendered output.
- Generate keys on the router with `generate pki wireguard key-pair` and keep the private key in ansible-vault.

## Usage

```yaml
- hosts: routers
  gather_facts: false
  roles:
    - vyos.blueprints.wireguard
```

## Variables

| Variable | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `wireguard_interfaces` | list |  | `[]` | WireGuard interfaces. Nothing is configured when empty. |
| `wireguard_interfaces.name` | str | yes |  | Interface name, e.g. `wg01`. |
| `wireguard_interfaces.addresses` | list | yes |  | Interface addresses in CIDR notation. |
| `wireguard_interfaces.description` | str |  |  | Interface description. |
| `wireguard_interfaces.port` | int |  |  | UDP listen port. |
| `wireguard_interfaces.private_key` | str |  |  | Base64 private key of this interface. |
| `wireguard_interfaces.mtu` | int |  |  | Interface MTU. |
| `wireguard_interfaces.peers` | list |  | `[]` | Peers. |
| `wireguard_interfaces.peers.name` | str | yes |  | Peer name, e.g. `OFFSITE1`. |
| `wireguard_interfaces.peers.public_key` | str | yes |  | Peer's base64 public key. |
| `wireguard_interfaces.peers.allowed_ips` | list | yes |  | Allowed IPs, e.g. `[0.0.0.0/0]` for a routed link. |
| `wireguard_interfaces.peers.address` | str |  |  | Peer endpoint address. |
| `wireguard_interfaces.peers.port` | int |  |  | Peer endpoint port. |
| `wireguard_interfaces.peers.persistent_keepalive` | int |  |  | Keepalive interval in seconds. |
| `wireguard_interfaces.peers.preshared_key` | str |  |  | Optional preshared key. |
| `vyos_blueprints_render_only` | bool |  | `false` | Collect commands into `vyos_blueprints_rendered` instead of configuring. |

## Entry point `verify` (`tasks_from: verify`)

Run with `tasks_from=verify`. Checks every WireGuard interface is up and every peer has completed a handshake.

| Variable | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `wireguard_interfaces` | list |  | `[]` | Same value as for `main`. |
